meaning.en: To an ample degree; liberally; fully.

sentences.en: But it was soon admitted (and notably by his colleagues on the judicial bench) to have been amply justified.

sentences.en: Thus the Liguorian system surpassed all its predecessors in securing uniformity in the confessional on a basis of established usage, two advantages amply sufficient to ensure its speedy general adoption within the Church of Rome.

sentences.en: At the same time, the repression of idealism and sentiment during the period of " illumination " was amply revenged, and the barren age of reason gave place to Romanticism.

sentences.en: This plain was, for those days, amply protected on three sides by the two rapid broad streams of the Tigris and its tributary Zab, by the hills on the N.E.

sentences.en: It is a system amply provided with checks and balances; it recognizes and enforces the principle of popular sovereignty, while subjecting that principle to many checks in practice; and it is well calculated to maintain unchanged the relation of its component parts each to the other.
sentences.vi: Nó là một amply hệ thống được cung cấp với các kiểm tra và số dư; nó thừa nhận và thực thi nguyên tắc chủ quyền phổ biến, đồng thời tuân theo nguyên tắc đó trước nhiều sự kiểm tra trong thực tế; và nó được tính toán tốt để duy trì không thay đổi mối quan hệ của các bộ phận thành phần của nó với nhau.

sentences.en: Its numerous root extractions amply justify a stronger expression than " multo labore," especially in an epitaph.
